# ixapi_de_cix_cloud_routers (Data Source)

Use the `cloud_routers` data source to find available DE-CIX Cloud ROUTER (VRF) instances



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cloud_routers` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--cloud_routers))
- `consuming_account` (String) Filter by consuming account ID
- `external_ref` (String) Filter by external reference
- `managing_account` (String) Filter by managing account ID

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--cloud_routers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cloud_routers`

Optional:

- `asn` (Number) Autonomous System Number (ASN) for the Cloud ROUTER
- `billing_account` (String) The account used for billing
- `capacity` (Number) Bandwidth capacity in Mbps
- `charged_until` (String) Service continues incurring charges until this date
- `consuming_account` (String) The account consuming the Cloud ROUTER service
- `decommission_at` (String) Service will be decommissioned on this date
- `external_ref` (String) External reference for the Cloud ROUTER
- `managing_account` (String) The account responsible for managing the Cloud ROUTER
- `metro_area_network` (String) Metro area network where Cloud ROUTER is deployed
- `product_offering` (String) Product offering ID for the Cloud ROUTER
- `state` (String)
- `status` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--cloud_routers--status))

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--cloud_routers--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cloud_routers.status`

Optional:

- `message` (String) A human readable message, describing the problem and may contain hints for resolution.
- `severity` (Number) We are using syslog severity levels: 0 = Emergency, 1 = Alert, 2 = Critical, 3 = Error, 4 = Warning, 5 = Notice, 6 = Informational, 7 = Debug.
- `tag` (String) A machine readable message identifier.
- `timestamp` (String) The time and date when the event occured.
